chillUnits.notes: No universal numeric chilling requirement is assigned. Check the actual cultivar and site's winter conditions.

supplementaryReferences.title: Irrigated Robertson trial context
supplementaryReferences.quote: All orchard plots are irrigated throughout summer on demand
supplementaryReferences.doc: Birkhofer et al. (2019), Effects of Ground Cover Management in Organic Deciduous Fruit Orchards in South Africa, Table 1
supplementaryReferences.note: The field experiment used managed organic orchards and found trade-offs in mulch effects; it does not justify a universal yield improvement from mulch.

care: Keep each cultivar's picking reference separate. The Robertson example used summer irrigation.
Confirm winter chilling, water and the actual planting material before using a reference as a local plan.
purchase: Solitaire has a sourced November first-pick reference and named chilling context at Simondium; discuss its local fit with the nursery.
Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
